hypothesis: Shape-led: W may contact Y39, GP may support a compact turn, and E may engage K43. A 10-aa exploratory hypothesis, not measured binding.
expected_discrimination: Targets the MSA Y39–S42 spacing of 5.7–5.8 Å rather than 8.4 Å in 8A9L or 7.5 Å in 6CU7.

hypothesis: Shape-led: a QPG turn presents aromatic and polar contacts toward Y39/S42, with D/E available for K43.
expected_discrimination: Tests recognition of the compact Y39–S42 geometry shared by all three MSA conformers; both controls have larger separation.

hypothesis: Shape-led: adjacent aromatics explore Y39 packing; PG limits backbone freedom and polar flanks temper hydrophobicity.
expected_discrimination: Multi-point docking should favor MSA L38–S42 spacing of 9.3–9.4 Å over 12.2 Å in 8A9L and 4.5 Å in 6CU7; aromatic nonspecificity is a risk.

hypothesis: Shape-led: Y provides a conservative aromatic anchor, with GP and distributed polar groups exploring the shared bent patch.
expected_discrimination: Tests simultaneous accommodation of MSA Y39–S42 at 5.7–5.8 Å and L38–S42 at 9.3–9.4 Å, unlike either control.

hypothesis: Shape-led: a longer soluble scaffold explores an NP-constrained aromatic-to-acidic contact arrangement without requiring deeply exposed V40.
expected_discrimination: Targets shared MSA patch geometry; the expanded 8A9L and locally collapsed 6CU7 arrangements may frustrate simultaneous contacts.

hypothesis: Charge-led: W supplies a Y39 anchor while separated D/E groups explore K43 engagement; lysines moderate net negative charge.
expected_discrimination: Charge alone cannot reject highly exposed K43 in 8A9L; selectivity must additionally match MSA Y39–S42 geometry, also distinct from 6CU7.

hypothesis: Charge-led: a polar aromatic scaffold samples alternative acidic contacts with consistently accessible MSA K43.
expected_discrimination: Predicted discrimination requires geometric cooperation, not K43 accessibility: Y39–S42 is 5.7–5.8 Å in MSA versus 8.4/7.5 Å in the controls.

hypothesis: Charge-led: Y and three distributed acidic residues test multiple K43-facing registers while polar residues limit hydrophobic aggregation.
expected_discrimination: Tests whether an acidic contact can be retained alongside MSA-specific L38–S42 spacing; either control disrupts that spacing.

hypothesis: Charge-led: a DE pair explores localized K43 capture, while glycine and polar flanks permit adjustment across the three MSA conformers.
expected_discrimination: Could fit MSA Y39–K43 distances of 8.3–8.7 Å versus 9.5 Å in 8A9L and 10.5 Å in 6CU7; the modest difference demands validation.

hypothesis: Charge-led: an extended, charge-balanced scaffold tests distributed acidic anchoring rather than a strongly anionic peptide.
expected_discrimination: Requires combined Y39/K43/S42 contacts matching MSA distances; higher control exposure alone is not evidence of weaker binding.

hypothesis: Polar-led: Y supplies an aromatic contact while N/S/Q/T explore hydrogen bonding near S42/T44; E/D may assist K43 engagement.
expected_discrimination: Targets MSA L38–S42 geometry; 8A9L is more extended and 6CU7 more collapsed. Side-chain hydrogen-bond geometry remains unprovided.

hypothesis: Polar-led: histidine and tyrosine diversify polar/aromatic recognition, with a glycine hinge for the conserved MSA bend.
expected_discrimination: Tests the MSA Y39–S42 spacing against both larger control values; any histidine-mediated advantage may depend on assay pH.

hypothesis: Polar-led: a low-hydrophobicity scaffold explores cooperative S42/T44 contacts, with Y39 and K43 as secondary anchors.
expected_discrimination: T44 is accessible in all MSA assemblies but less exposed in 6CU7; rejection of 8A9L must come from its different geometry, not SASA.

hypothesis: Polar-led: a flexible polar scaffold tests whether adaptable hydrogen-bond contacts accommodate all MSA conformers without a proline-enforced turn.
expected_discrimination: Targets shared MSA Y39–S42 and L38–S42 distances; flexibility could also accommodate controls, making this a useful specificity-risk alternative.

hypothesis: Polar-led: a 22-aa soluble alternative explores a broader contact footprint using H/Y, polar residues and modest acidity. All proposals are cysteine-free; no first-round feedback was supplied.
expected_discrimination: Tests cooperative recognition of the MSA 38–44 arrangement rather than exposure alone; longer-scaffold flexibility may weaken discrimination against both controls.
